items.title: Redis RAG Workbench
items.description: Interactive demo to build a RAG-based chatbot over a user-uploaded PDF. Toggle different settings and configurations to improve chatbot performance and quality. Utilizes RedisVL, LangChain, RAGAs, and more.

items.title: Redis VSS - Simple Streamlit Demo
items.description: Streamlit demo of Redis Vector Search

items.title: ArXiv Search
items.description: Full stack implementation of Redis with React FE

items.title: ArxivChatGuru
items.description: Streamlit demo of RAG over Arxiv documents with Redis & OpenAI

items.title: Redis Movies Searcher
items.description: Demo of hybrid search using Java, Spring Boot, and Redis OM

items.title: Memory-Aware Alexa Assistant
items.description: Complete example of an Alexa skill that can recall previously stored conversations and memories to provide contextual responses to users. Utilizes Redis Agent Memory Server, LangChain4J, Terraform, and AWS. It showcases how to implement context engineering to dynamically leverage RAG, tools, short-term and long-term memories.

items.title: From Postgres to Redis Cloud with RDI
items.description: This demo shows how to deploy RDI on Kubernetes running locally so it can be used to build a moving/transformation data pipeline to enable data on Redis Cloud. The source database lives on-premises, and the data is movied and transformed to Redis Cloud.

items.title: Virtual Banking Assistant with Semantic Router
items.description: A Banking Agent demo that uses semantic routing to route user queries to right banking tool. (Eg: Credit Card Recommendation, Loan EMI calculation, Banking FAQ etc)

items.title: Shopping AI Agent
items.description: An Agentic AI grocery-shopping platform demo that combines Redis's speed with LangGraph's workflow orchestration. Get personalized recipe recommendations, smart product suggestions, and lightning-fast responses through semantic caching.

items.title: Restaurant Discovery AI Agent
items.description: An Agentic AI restaurant discovery platform that combines Redis's speed with LangGraph's intelligent workflow orchestration. Get personalized restaurant recommendations, make reservations, and get lightning-fast responses through semantic caching.

items.title: Podcast Chatbot with Agent Memory
items.description: A chatbot that discusses and recommends podcasts. Affectionately called Podbot, it demonstrates how to use Redis Agent Memory Server to build context-aware agents with Azure Managed Redis.

items.title: Car Dealership Assistant with Agent Memory
items.description: A Car Dealership chatbot with Redis Agent Memory Server, showcasing short-term and long-term memory.

items.title: Multi-Agent AI Text Adventure Game with Agent Memory and LangGraph.js
items.description: A text-adventure game that demonstrates how to build a multi-agent AI workflows with LangGraph.js, Azure Managed Redis, and Agent Memory Server.
